facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs said on 1 October 2026 that the department will turn 'in the new year' to automating the birth, marriage and death registration process, working with public and private healthcare providers so that a parent can register a birth without a form or a queue; it is stated as an intention, not as a system in use.
facts.system: automated birth, marriage and death registration process
